headline: DeepSeek, Tencent dominate; Google surges on flash
summary: DeepSeek's v4-flash holds the crown at 15.3% token share despite a small daily dip, while Tencent's HY3 climbs to 14.0%. Google's Gemini-3.6-flash jumped five ranks in a day to hit rank 9, and NVIDIA's fresh Nemotron-3.5-lightning entry already claims an all-time record at 1.0% share. Two models exited the top 51, while upstage and Moonshot AI added new entrants.
highlights: DeepSeek v4-flash (15.3%) and Tencent HY3 (14.0%) command the top two spots; DeepSeek provider share hits 26.4%
Google Gemini-3.6-flash vaults 5 ranks to #9 (3.4% share) in a single day
NVIDIA Nemotron-3.5-lightning debuts at rank 21 with 1.0% share—an all-time record for the model
Anthropic Claude-opus-5 sets all-time high at 3.1% share
OpenAI's GPT-5.6-luna climbs 27 spots on the 30-day chart (7.8% share, rank 3)
Xiaomi's MIMO-v2.5 slides 3 ranks in one day, down 6 over 30 days (4.2% share)
